text:
jess: FYI - HelioHealth is asking for a retroactive credit for invoice INV-2026-0432. They say an onboarding config mistake caused 3x overage in Q1. Also requesting Net45 instead of our standard Net30 for the next 2 invoices. Can finance weigh in?
raj: +1 for handling quickly, their contract renewal is in 6 weeks. If we stall we risk churn. How much are they asking for?
maya: Need numbers to approve. What's the disputed amount and what's the proposed remedy (credit vs. discount vs. one-off waiver)? Also, any precedent?
jess: They propose a $45,600 credit (they uploaded a breakdown). They want the credit applied to invoice INV-2026-0432 and Net45 for next two invoices. Sales suggests a one-time credit and then revisit at renewal.
raj: We tracked the spike to a misrouted training job that retried massively — confirmed by infra logs. Here's snippet from their usage export:```project: helio-prod
start: 2026-02-01
end: 2026-02-28
peak_tokens: 9.8M/day (expected 3M)
notes: retry-loop on onboarding worker v2.1```
oliver: From RevOps: if we apply a $45.6k credit we should tag it as "customer_recovery_credit" GL 4802 and mark reason code "onboarding_misconfig". Need approval from Legal for Net45 term change.
carlos: Can approve Net45 for two invoices as a business accommodation. Legal wants a short amendment: one paragraph, no change to SLA or pricing schedule, only payment terms for the specified invoices. I can draft and sign.
maya: Finance needs to approve the dollar amount. Two questions: 1) Is this credit retroactive to avoid billing dispute (i.e., reduce recognized revenue now)? 2) Do we require the amendment before granting Net45?
jess: They want the credit applied immediately and said they won't dispute if credited. They can sign the amendment within 48 hours.
maya: OK, here's a recommended path: - Approve one-time $45,600 customer recovery credit (charge code CR-ONBOARD-01). - Apply credit to INV-2026-0432 and issue corrected invoice. - Grant Net45 for next two invoices conditional on signed amendment. - RevOps to create internal memo for revenue ops.
raj: :thumbsup: Sounds reasonable. Can we cap any further retro credits? Just to document scope: one-time only.
oliver: I'll create the RevOps memo and update the billing record. Please confirm the aging bucket adjustment: move INV-2026-0432 from "open" to "adjusted" once credit applied.
maya: Approving $45,600 one-time credit under standard approval limits. Approver: Maya (Finance Lead). Condition: amendment signed within 72 hours and no SLA changes. Please route to Legal for signature and to Billing for invoice correction.
carlos: I'll attach the amendment draft here and request e-sign from HelioHealth.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0432 attached: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0432 — current balance $152,340 — note: hold collections pending adjustment.
jess: Thanks all — I'll coordinate with HelioHealth and loop back when signed. Raj, can you confirm renewal outreach timeline?
raj: I'll push renewal meeting up by one week. If amendment signed, push for upsell conversation.
maya: Marking this thread as approved pending doc. I'll create the internal PR for the GL change after billing posts adjusted invoice. :white_check_mark:
jess: Great, closing loop here. Thanks everyone.
